verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance case-management SaaS, so outbound webhooks are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence shows only inbound APIs (Alerts, Case, import), list/fetch endpoints, filing-status monitoring over API, and in-app/email notifications. None of these is a documented, registrable outbound HTTP callback, and the developer docs are password-gated, so no webhook capability is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
